description: This PHP source file defines the 'WrappedHttpHandler' class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class adapts an HTTP handler to a command-specific handler, managing request execution, response parsing, and error handling. It includes methods to invoke the handler, parse responses, and handle errors, using dependencies like Guzzle Promise and PSR-7 message interfaces.

classes.name: WrappedHttpHandler
classes.description: A class that converts a general HTTP handler into a command-specific AWS HTTP handler, managing response and error parsing, and optionally collecting transfer stats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with HTTP handler, response parsers, exception class, and stats collection option.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the HTTP handler with the provided command and request, returns a promise resolving to AWS result or rejects with AWS exception.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response into an AWS result object, including metadata such as status code, headers, and transfer statistics.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Converts an error response and associated exception into an AWS exception, parsing error details and managing error messages.
